_partNote: Six classes, four of which are things done to a strand of DNA, so the strand entries are separated by what the outline does rather than by molecular detail: an X (scissors), a horizontal bar with one loop rising off it (base and prime editing), a vertical lollipop (RNA hairpin), and a thin-thick-thin bar (a cassette dropped into a strand). The two delivery classes are both round and are split single-versus-many: one large hard faceted capsid against a loose cluster of small smooth spheres.

Drawn large and bold so the X fills the frame, with generous open space between the blades. One object only. Nothing being cut, no strand, no molecule, no paper, no hand, no vessel and no equipment.
